artworks.title: Dorothea Rawlins
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up. The woman has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and a small mouth. Her curly hair is styled with pearls woven into it on one side. She is wearing a draped garment with a lace-trimmed neckline, a robe over her shoulders, a necklace, a brooch on her bodice, and her hands are holding the fabric of her robe. In the background, there is an architectural column, a draped curtain, and a seascape with a ship in the distance. Text at the bottom mentions D. Dorothea Narbona, Thomas Rawlins, and various titles and regions.

artworks.title: Bernardin Realinus, Jesuit Priest
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic portrait engraving of an older man. He is seated facing slightly left, holding a round cane or staff with both hands. The man has a round face with defined features, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and thin lips. He has short, neatly cropped hair, facial stubble, and wears a long, dark robe over a high-collared shirt. The background contains circular motifs with religious insignias, and there are inscriptions in Latin at the top and bottom of the image identifying the subject and artist.

artworks.title: Quirinus Rechlinger
artworks.description: The image depicts a man shown from the waist upwards in a formal portrait. He is positioned facing forward, but his head is slightly turned to the right. The man has a round face with prominent cheekbones and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His hair is short and neatly combed. He wears a dark, heavy garment with a decorative high collar, known as a ruff. Draped around his neck is a long chain, and in his left hand, he holds a small object that resembles a book. The background is intricately decorated with scrollwork and heraldic symbols, surrounded by a frame featuring inscriptions. The frame includes ornamental elements such as crests and shields. Text surrounds the portrait's oval frame, conveying a richly detailed and ornate formal nature of the portrait.

artworks.title: Everhard Reidan, Friend of William the Silent
artworks.description: This image depicts a man's upper body facing forward with his head slightly turned to the left. The man has distinctive facial features, a full beard with a styled mustache, and short, groomed hair. He is wearing formal attire with a high-collared garment and an elaborate ruff collar, decorated with visible buttons. The image is framed by an ornate oval frame containing inscriptions about his identity and biographical information. Below the portrait, there is text presented in verse. The background features a dark textured gradient.

artworks.title: Georgius Remus
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of an elderly man from the waist up. He has a pointed beard and mustache, is mostly bald with some hair on the sides, and has pronounced facial features. He wears elaborate attire including a dark coat with puffed sleeves and a pleated ruff collar. A pendant is around his neck, and he holds a rolled paper or scroll. The image is bordered by Latin text and decorative elements, including a bull and shield emblem.

artworks.title: Don Luis de Requesens
artworks.description: The image displays a man in a formal pose. He has distinct facial features including a high forehead, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, mustache, and neatly trimmed beard. His hair is bald on top with some hair around the sides. He is wearing a detailed outfit with a high collar and ornate armor decorated with intricate designs. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with decorative scrollwork, motifs, and faces. The background features architectural elements, figures, and ornamental patterns.

artworks.title: Nicolas Reusner
artworks.description: The engraving shows a portrait from the chest up of a man named Nicolaus Reusnerus. He is positioned facing forward and slightly to the left, with a large, elaborate hat featuring a wide band adorned with a circular emblem. His facial features include a rounded face, prominent cheekbones, bushy eyebrows, and a long, full beard that extends down past his collared shirt. He is wearing a ruff or pleated collar around his neck and a cloak draped over his shoulders. His right hand is partially visible, holding what appears to be sheets of paper or a small book. The background includes an architectural arch border and decorative elements such as flowers and butterflies. The top of the engraving displays the name "NICOLAUS REUSNERUS IC."

artworks.title: Richard I of England
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person from the chest up, positioned in profile facing slightly to the right. The person has distinct facial features, a prominent nose, and long, wavy hair peeking out from under a crown. They wear detailed armor and hold a sword in their right hand. An oval frame with Latin inscriptions surrounds them, with crests above the left and right of the frame. Below the engraving is a block of text offering additional information. The background includes decorative elements that enhance the historical and noble impression of the engraving.

artworks.title: Richard II of England
artworks.description: The image displays a waist-up portrait of a person seated in an upright position. The person's facial features include a solemn expression with prominent eyes and slightly parted lips, and their hair is styled in a shoulder-length, wavy fashion, fitting under a large ornate crown adorned with small floral details. They are dressed in elaborate royal attire, including a fur-trimmed cloak and a detailed chain or necklace across their chest, which features intricate designs including crosses and circular emblems. The person's clothing is richly decorated. In their hands, they hold a sceptre in the right hand and an orb in the left. The setting includes an ornate border around the portrait, featuring scrolling designs and additional heraldic symbols including shields and a Latin inscription naming "Richards II" surrounded by a decorative frame. The background is a simple, etched texture, highlighting the central figure.

artworks.title: Richard II of England
artworks.description: An engraved portrait depicts Richard II, King of England. He is seated upright, wearing a crown adorned with floral designs, jewels, and crosses. He is dressed in regal attire, holding a scepter in his right hand and cradling an orb in his left. The background features ornate scrollwork, heraldic symbols, and text. Below the image, there is a paragraph of historical context about the king.

artworks.title: Richard III of England
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a bust of a man labeled as "Richard III." He is positioned facing slightly right, looking ahead with a serious expression. His facial features include deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and slightly parted lips, with medium-length wavy hair under a cap adorned with a star emblem. He is dressed in elaborate clothing with a fur collar, a jeweled chain across his chest, holding a staff in his right hand, and supporting a spherical object topped with a cross in his left hand. The background is ornate with decorative scrollwork and crests, and text below the image provides historical context.

artworks.title: Richard III of England
artworks.description: An engraved portrait features a figure in a forward-facing seated position. The person wears a cap with a star-like emblem, and has a long face with high cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a long nose. Their medium-length wavy hair is light-colored. The ornate clothing includes a fur collar over an embroidered garment, with a chain of office around the neck. The individual holds a scepter in their left hand and an orb in the right. The background shows intricate engravings of patterns, crowns, and heraldic symbols within an oval frame. Inscriptions in Latin surround the oval, with a historical description in English at the bottom.

artworks.title: Philps van dorp Ridder, Dutch Admiral
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man. He is wearing a hat with feathers, has wavy hair, a distinct mustache, and is dressed in historical attire. The background has horizontal lines and there is an inscription surrounding the portrait. Text within a banner at the bottom adds to the classical appearance of the portrait.

artworks.title: Nicholas Ridley, Bishop of London, Protestant Martyr
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This is a portrait image of a man. The man is seated and positioned in a three-quarter profile, facing to his left. He has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard and mustache. His hair is medium-length and swept back, revealing a receding hairline. He is wearing a cloak over a shirt with a visible collar. In his right hand, he is holding a closed book with clasps on the front cover. The background has a shaded texture, and below the image, there is a printed label with text, including the name "NICOLAUS RIDLEIVS," and a few lines in Latin.

artworks.title: Andreas Rivetus
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body positioned in a three-quarter view. He has a full face, prominent cheekbones, and a somewhat pointed chin. He has a goatee and a narrow mustache, and dark, wavy hair that is combed back. He is wearing a large, stiff white ruff collar, a dark garment with intricate patterns on the shoulders, and faint buttons on his vest. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background features an ornate frame with decorative border lines surrounding an arch, with Greek text above his head. At the bottom is text identifying the man as "Andreas Rivetus SS. Theolog. Doct. & Professor," with additional information and the artist's signature.

artworks.title: Andreas Rivetus, Doctor of Divinity and Professor
artworks.description: The image features an engraved portrait of a man, depicted from the chest up. He is facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has aged facial features, including lines around his eyes and forehead, along with a neatly trimmed mustache and goatee. His hair is styled back, revealing a high forehead and receding hairline. He is dressed in a dark, buttoned-up garment with a broad, white pleated collar. The engraving is set within an oval frame, with an ornate band containing text below the image. The background features fine crosshatching.

artworks.title: Saint Robert, Founder and First Abbot of the Cistercian Monks
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing, facing right. He has a mature face, with a high forehead and short, neatly combed hair in a tonsure style. He wears a long, flowing robe with wide sleeves, likely a monastic garment, cinched at the waist. He holds a staff in his right hand and a small object in his left. In the background are trees, water, and mountains. In the top left corner, there is a smaller image of a saint. At the bottom, there is Latin text.

artworks.title: Nicholas Roccoxius
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a chair. He has a beard, mustache, and short, neat hair. He wears a ruff, a dark garment, and a fur-lined robe. His right hand rests on papers on a table with a cloth. On the table, there is a sculpted bust and a closed book with a bookmark. Nearby is another sculpted bust of a bearded man. The background has columns, a curtain, and a view of a cityscape with a spire. It seems to be an interior with classical architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Venerable Alphonsus Rodriguez
artworks.description: The image is a drawn portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. The man is positioned facing slightly to the left, with his hands clasped together in front of him, holding a rosary. His facial features are solemn, with a prominent forehead, deep-set eyes looking upward, and a closely cut beard. The man has a bald head with a fringe of hair on the sides and back. He is wearing a high-collared, dark robe. The background is a textured pattern.

artworks.title: John Rogers, Prebendary of Saint Paul's, Protestant Martyr
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body. The man is seated and turned slightly to his left, with his right hand visible near his chest. He has a thoughtful expression. His facial features include a mustache and beard, and wavy hair reaching the nape of his neck. He wears a robe-like garment with a wide collar and layered clothing beneath. The man holds a document or book in his right hand. The background features a densely hatched pattern.

artworks.title: Rudolph II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a man in a bust-length portrait within an elaborate frame. He faces slightly to his left with a serious expression. The man has short hair and a trimmed beard and mustache, wearing richly detailed clothing, including ornate armor and a high ruff around his neck. An oval frame surrounds him with inscribed text, and cherubic figures blowing trumpets flank the oval. Above the frame, an eagle holds a globe with outstretched wings. Below, two cherubic figures sit on lions for symmetry. The background is filled with intricate patterns and classical elements.

artworks.title: Rudolph II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing slightly to the right. He is sitting upright, holding a scepter in one hand and a globe in the other. The man has a beard, mustache, slightly furrowed brow, swept-back hair with a laurel wreath, and wears patterned clothing with a high collar and ruff. He has a cloak fastened by a brooch and wears an ornate chain around his neck. In the background, there is a heraldic crest to the right, with detailed etching.

artworks.title: Rudolph II in Chariot Drawn by Lion and Eagle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a kingly figure being carried by a chariot with eagles and a lion through the clouds above a cityscape. Mythological figures are depicted on clouds, and a city with spires is shown below. The drawing features a figure on a chariot, surrounded by a radiant aura. The chariot is pulled by eagles and a lion. Above, in the sky, mythological figures are shown amidst swirling clouds. Below is a detailed cityscape with various buildings and towers. Latin text is included at the top of the image. The artwork showcases intricate line work and shading techniques, creating depth and texture in the clouds and the chariot's presence.

artworks.title: Rudolph II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, including his head, shoulders, and upper torso. He is facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a beard and mustache, neatly styled medium-length facial hair, and is wearing a tall, cylindrical hat. His hair is cropped on the sides and voluminous on top. He wears elaborate attire typical of the Renaissance period, with a large ruffed collar and a decorated garment with a chest band. The oval frame surrounding him contains intricate engravings and Latin text. The background features a textured pattern, and there are illustrated birds perched on both sides of the oval border.
